notes:
Speccify 0.11.4 is a Mac patch. Windows remains on 0.11.0.

- Existing Agent conversations stay visible when switching between applications or refreshing the selected content source.
- A pending source check or temporary read error preserves the confirmed session, conversation and unsent input in the same terminal view.
- Actual source or process changes still require the existing identity checks. Opening an Agent does not start another session.

Use Environment → Updates to install the Mac patch, or download the Mac installer from https://speccify.io/download/. The normal updater checks unsaved work before restarting.
